'''Incom reconnaissance craft X396''' was a [[StealthX]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] operated by [[Ohali Soroc]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[new Jedi Order]]. The [[R9-series astromech droid]] [[Nineball]] functioned as the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]]. In [[45 ABY]], while searching for for the [[Mortis monolith/Legends|Mortis monolith]], Soroc flew the StealthX to the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]]<ref name="Crucible" /> in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Soroc was ambushed by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] ''[[Bes'uliik]]'' starfighters in the [[Bubble of the Lost]] region of the Chiloon Rift near to a [[Unidentified monolith|monolith of unknown origin]]. The StealthX was crippled and Soroc was captured by the Mandalorians' employer, [[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]].<ref name="Crucible" />
 
The remains of the StealthX were recovered by the Mandalorians and later rigged to emit a false distress call on the [[RiftMesh]] communications network to lure the  the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], as well as a [[Miy'tari Scout]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knights [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Tahiri Veila]], into [[Ambush at Ohali Soroc's supposed crash site|an ambush]].<ref name="Crucible" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Incom reconnaissance craft X396 appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
